title: Esquire Bank Named #1 Best Law Firm Funding Provider in The Recorder's "Best Of" Survey
summary: Esquire Financial Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ESQ) (the "Company"), the financial holding company for Esquire Bank, National Association ("Esquire Bank" or the "Bank") (collectively "Esquire"), today announced that it has been named the #1 Best Law Firm Funding Provider in The Recorder's 2026 "Best Of" survey. The Bank also earned Hall of Fame status, a distinction reserved for companies that have ranked among the top three in the survey for three or more of the past four years. The Recorder's annual "Best Of" survey recognizes the top providers serving California's legal community. Voted on by attorneys, in-house counsel, judges, law firms and legal department administrators, Esquire's first-place ranking reflects the legal profession's confidence and support while underscoring Esquire's longstanding commitment to addressing the unique needs and wants of plaintiff law firms.
